name: flauz-backup
description: Flauz durable-state backup/export and crash recovery: a byte-identical export of the durable .flauz/ census surfaces (the resources graph, the ops-chain, the environments registry, the evidence ledger, the browser-session journal, the workflow envelopes, the tasks file, the orchestration state, the provider-lanes state) with a per-surface manifest and export-time integrity verdicts, an export verifier (green/tampered/torn per surface), and the verify-first restore path with atomic per-surface stage+rename and a recovery record banked into the restored state.

commands.title: Restore Durable State From Export (Crash Recovery)
